description: Full-text search across the FAA handbooks, advisory circulars and other reference documents in Aviation Resources (for example the Pilot's Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge, Airplane Flying Handbook, Instrument Flying Handbook, Aviation Weather and the Weight & Balance Handbook). Returns the best-matching documents, each with its best pages and short snippets. Use it to find where a topic is covered, then call get_page to read a page in full or see its figures. Cite pages with their viewerUrl.

offset.description: How many documents to skip, for the next page of results (pagination.offset + pagination.limit).

pagesPerResource.description: How many of each document's best pages to return.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. holding entry or "density altitude". Words must all match (English variants count); use "quotes" for a phrase, or for alternatives, and -word to exclude. Use the words an FAA handbook would use; search for an ACS task's topic, not its code.

resourceIds.description: Only search these documents (IDs from earlier results). Leave out to search every document.

name: search_documents

hasMore.description: True when calling again with offset + limit returns more documents.

total.description: Number of matching documents across all pages of results.

query.description: The query as it was run.

results.description: Matching documents, best first. Empty when nothing matches.

matchedPageCount.description: How many pages of the document match; pages holds only the best of them.

heading.description: Section heading the passage falls under.

snippet.description: Plain text around the matched words, excerpts joined by " … ".

pageNumber.description: 1-based page number in the PDF. Pass to get_page to read or see the page.

viewerUrl.description: Opens this page in the Aviation Resources web app. Give this to the user as the source link.

id.description: UUID of the document. Pass it to get_page, or in resourceIds to search only this document.

score.description: Relevance within this response only; higher is better.

title: Search FAA Documents
